title: Monument Preservation
goal: I can describe a restoration with a participle before the noun, as in *a rétegeket tiszteletben tartó felújítás*.
I can say what happened to a wall with a past participle, as in *a pusztulástól megóvott fal*.
I can use the main words of monument protection.
